chain_words.nuance: gives an approximate value based on partial data
derives a value from data using a stated method
obtains a value directly with an instrument or standard
establishes a precise value or fact with confidence
expresses an effect or variable exactly as a number

explanation: These words all describe obtaining a value from observation or data, but with increasing precision, from a rough estimate to an exact numerical result.

usage_notes.difference: 'Estimate' gives an approximate value that may be revised, while 'quantify' expresses the same effect exactly as a number.
